WITH complaint_hw AS (

    FROM Complaints c

    WHERE p.product_category_code = 'Hardware'
      AND c.date_complaint_raised > '2005-01-01'
),
individual_counts AS (
    SELECT staff_id AS individual_id, 'staff' AS ind_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           MAX(date_complaint_raised) AS last_date
    FROM complaint_hw
    GROUP BY staff_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT customer_id AS individual_id, 'customer' AS ind_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           MAX(date_complaint_raised) AS last_date
    FROM complaint_hw
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
max_cnt AS (
    SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt FROM individual_counts
),
top_individual AS (
    SELECT ic.individual_id, ic.ind_type, ic.cnt, ic.last_date
    FROM individual_counts ic
    JOIN max_cnt mc ON ic.cnt = mc.max_cnt
    ORDER BY ic.last_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_phone AS (
    SELECT CASE ti.ind_type
             WHEN 'staff' THEN s.phone_number
             ELSE cu.phone_number
           END AS phone_number
    FROM top_individual ti
    LEFT JOIN Staff s ON ti.ind_type = 'staff' AND ti.individual_id = s.staff_id
    LEFT JOIN Customers cu ON ti.ind_type = 'customer' AND ti.individual_id = cu.customer_id
)

WITH filtered_complaints AS (

      AND c.date_complaint_raised > '2005-01-01'

           COUNT(*) AS cnt,

    FROM filtered_complaints
    GROUP BY customer_id

    SELECT staff_id AS individual_id, 'staff' AS role,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           MAX(date_complaint_raised) AS recent_date
    FROM filtered_complaints
    GROUP BY staff_id
),
top_individual AS (
    SELECT individual_id, role, cnt, recent_date
    FROM individual_stats
    WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM individual_stats)
    ORDER BY recent_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_phone AS (
    SELECT ti.individual_id,
           ti.role,
           (
               SELECT cu.phone_number
               FROM filtered_complaints fc

                 AND fc.date_complaint_raised = ti.recent_date
               ORDER BY fc.complaint_id DESC
               LIMIT 1
           ) AS phone_number
    FROM top_individual ti
)

FROM filtered_complaints fc

FROM Complaints AS c
JOIN Products AS p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Customers AS cust ON c.customer_id = cust.customer_id
WHERE p.product_category_code = 'Hardware'
  AND c.complaint_status_code = 'Closed';

SELECT cu.phone_number, co.date_complaint_closed
FROM Complaints co
JOIN Products p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Customers cu ON co.customer_id = cu.customer_id
WHERE p.product_category_code = 'Hardware'
AND co.complaint_status_code = 'Closed'

SELECT cus."phone_number" AS phone_number, comp."date_complaint_closed" AS closing_date FROM "Complaints" comp JOIN "Products" prod ON comp."product_id" = prod."product_id" JOIN "Customers" cus ON comp."customer_id" = cus."customer_id" WHERE prod."product_category_code" = 'Hardware' AND comp."complaint_status_code" = 'Closed';

SELECT s.phone_number, c.date_complaint_closed
FROM Complaints c
JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Staff s ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id
WHERE p.product_category_code = 'Hardware'
  AND c.complaint_status_code = 'Closed';

SELECT cu.email_address
FROM Complaints AS co
JOIN Customers AS cu ON co.customer_id = cu.customer_id
WHERE co.complaint_type_code = 'Product Failure'
  AND co.date_complaint_raised >= '2001-01-01'
ORDER BY co.date_complaint_raised;

SELECT DISTINCT c.email_address
FROM Customers c
JOIN Complaints comp ON c.customer_id = comp.customer_id
WHERE comp.complaint_type_code = 'Product Failure'
  AND strftime('%Y', comp.date_complaint_raised) > '2000'
ORDER BY comp.date_complaint_raised

SELECT p.product_name AS product_name, c.date_complaint_raised AS date, s.first_name AS first_name, s.last_name AS last_name FROM Complaints c INNER JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN Staff s ON c.staff_id = s.staff_id WHERE c.complaint_status_code = 'Open' AND c.date_complaint_raised = (SELECT MAX(c2.date_complaint_raised) FROM Complaints c2 WHERE c2.product_id = c.product_id AND c2.complaint_status_code = 'Open')

WITH open_latest AS (
    SELECT product_id, MAX(date_complaint_raised) AS latest_date
    FROM Complaints
    WHERE complaint_status_code = 'Open'
    GROUP BY product_id
)

    p.product_name,
    ol.latest_date AS date_complaint_raised,
    s.first_name,
    s.last_name

JOIN Complaints c

   AND c.complaint_status_code = 'Open'
JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = c.product_id
JOIN Staff s ON s.staff_id = c.staff_id;
